ticketLinking.title: Ticket Linking - Linear/Jira Integration
ticketLinking.description: Configuration for detecting and displaying ticket references with auto-context injection

linearApiKey.description: Linear API key for ticket resolution (from env: LINEAR_API_KEY)
linearApiKey.markdownDescription: Linear GraphQL API key. Get from https://linear.app/settings/api. Also check `LINEAR_API_KEY` env var.

jiraApiKey.description: Jira API key for ticket resolution (from env: JIRA_API_KEY)
jiraApiKey.markdownDescription: Jira Cloud API token. Get from https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Also check `JIRA_API_KEY` env var.

jiraInstance.markdownDescription: Jira Cloud instance URL. From env: `JIRA_INSTANCE`

githubToken.description: GitHub personal access token for ticket resolution (from env: GITHUB_TOKEN)
githubToken.markdownDescription: GitHub PAT with `repo` scope. Get from https://github.com/settings/tokens. Also check `GITHUB_TOKEN` env var.

cacheExpiry.description: Ticket metadata cache expiry in seconds

autoShowPanel.description: Automatically show ticket panel when tickets are detected

debounceMs.description: Debounce interval for ticket detection on document change (milliseconds)

contextWindowLines.description: Number of lines before/after to capture for context

excludePatterns.description: File patterns to exclude from scanning

inlineDecorations.description: Show inline decorations (links) for detected tickets
